name: Image Aspect Ratio Tagging
description: Tags images with their aspect ratio (for responsive layout/CSS handling).
project_description:
This module adds a field to the "image" media type that automatically populates with the aspect ratio of the image. This allows for faster searching of image by aspect ratio. 

 If there is interest in this project, we will consider expanding the scope to be used across other bundles and field names.
